name: Asset - Maintenance Schedule

parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.asset_code, a.name, a.location, a.assigned_to, m.scheduled_date, m.maintenance_type, c.channel_id FROM ast_maintenance_schedules m JOIN ast_assets a ON a.id = m.asset_id JOIN ast_it_managers c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE m.scheduled_date BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' AND m.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL;
